- Among the comparable, non-M&A-driven airlines, **United Airlines** shows the strongest revenue growth momentum — both the highest single-year YoY growth (6.23%, essentially tied with Delta's 6.19%) and clearly the highest two-year compound annual growth rate (12.66%) from FY2022 through FY2024, reflecting a stronger sustained post-pandemic revenue recovery than Delta, Southwest, or American.
- American Airlines shows the weakest momentum on both metrics (2.70% YoY, 5.21% 2-yr CAGR).

ANSWER: United Airlines showed the strongest genuine (organic) revenue growth momentum through FY2024 — 6.23% YoY (2023→2024) and a 12.66% two-year CAGR (2022→2024), both the highest among Delta, United, Southwest, American, and Alaska. Alaska's reported 12.56% YoY growth appears highest but is not comparable, since it is inflated by ~$869M of revenue from the September 2024 Hawaiian Holdings acquisition; excluding that, Alaska's organic growth (~4.2% YoY) was actually the weakest of the five.
